```typescript
/**
 * Resize an image buffer while preserving the original format.
 * Simplified version of Next.js image optimizer's optimizeImage function (https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/9436dce61f1a3ff9478261dc2eba47e0527acf3d/packages/next/src/server/image-optimizer.ts#L640).
 * Supports common web image formats (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF) with format-specific
 * optimization settings. Drops advanced options like limitInputPixels, sequentialRead,
 * and timeout that aren't needed for logo processing. Uses failOnError: false for
 * better robustness with potentially malformed images.
 */
export async function resizeImage(params: {
  buffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height?: number;
  quality?: number;
  contentType?: string;
}): Promise<{ buffer: Buffer; contentType: string }> {
  const { buffer, width, height, quality = 100 } = params;
  let { contentType } = params;

  // Auto-detect content type if not provided
  if (!contentType) {
    contentType = (await detectContentType(buffer)) ?? PNG;
  }

  const transformer = sharp(buffer).rotate();

  if (height) {
    transformer.resize(width, height);
  } else {
    transformer.resize(width, undefined, { withoutEnlargement: true });
  }

  // Apply format-specific optimization (preserving original format)
  if (contentType === AVIF) {
    transformer.avif({
      quality: Math.max(quality - 20, 1),
      effort: 3,
    });
  } else if (contentType === WEBP) {
    transformer.webp({ quality });
  } else if (contentType === PNG) {
    transformer.png({ quality });
  } else if (contentType === JPEG) {
    transformer.jpeg({ quality, mozjpeg: true });
  } else {
    // For unknown formats, default to PNG
    transformer.png({ quality });
    contentType = PNG;
  }

  const optimizedBuffer = await transformer.toBuffer();
  return { buffer: optimizedBuffer, contentType };
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Resize an image buffer while preserving the original format.
 * Simplified version of Next.js image optimizer's optimizeImage function (https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/9436dce61f1a3ff9478261dc2eba47e0527acf3d/packages/next/src/server/image-optimizer.ts#L640).
 * Supports common web image formats (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF) with format-specific
 * optimization settings. Drops advanced options like limitInputPixels, sequentialRead,
 * and timeout that aren't needed for logo processing. Uses failOnError: false for
 * better robustness with potentially malformed images.
 */
export async function resizeImage(params: {
  buffer: Buffer;
  width: number;
  height?: number;
  quality?: number;
  contentType?: string;
}): Promise<{ buffer: Buffer; contentType: string }> {
  const { buffer, width, height, quality = 100 } = params;
  let { contentType } = params;

  // Auto-detect content type if not provided
  if (!contentType) {
    contentType = (await detectContentType(buffer)) ?? PNG;
  }

  const transformer = sharp(buffer).rotate();

  if (height) {
    transformer.resize(width, height);
  } else {
    transformer.resize(width, undefined, { withoutEnlargement: true });
  }

  // Apply format-specific optimization (preserving original format)
  if (contentType === AVIF) {
    transformer.avif({
      quality: Math.max(quality - 20, 1),
      effort: 3,
    });
  } else if (contentType === WEBP) {
    transformer.webp({ quality });
  } else if (contentType === PNG) {
    transformer.png({ quality });
  } else if (contentType === JPEG) {
    transformer.jpeg({ quality, mozjpeg: true });
  } else {
    // For unknown formats, default to PNG
    transformer.png({ quality });
    contentType = PNG;
  }

  const optimizedBuffer = await transformer.toBuffer();
  return { buffer: optimizedBuffer, contentType };
}

async function detectContentTypeMetadata(buffer: Buffer): Promise<{ value: string | null | PromiseLike<string | null> }> {

  // Fallback to sharp metadata detection
  try {
    const meta = await sharp(buffer).metadata();
    switch (meta?.format) {
      case "avif":
        return { value: AVIF };
      case "webp":
        return { value: WEBP };
      case "png":
        return { value: PNG };
      case "jpeg":
      case "jpg":
        return { value: JPEG };
      case "gif":
        return { value: GIF };
      case "svg":
        return { value: SVG };
      default:
        return { value: null };
    }
  } catch {
    return { value: null };
  }
}
```

```typescript
function getAndUpdateNormalizedValues(field: RhfFormFields[number], t: TFunction) {
  let noLabel = false;
  let hidden = !!field.hidden;
  if (field.type === "radioInput") {
    const options = field.options;

    // If we have only one option and it has an input, we don't show the field label because Option name acts as label.
    // e.g. If it's just Attendee Phone Number option then we don't show `Location` label
    if (options?.length === 1) {
      if (!field.optionsInputs) {
        throw new Error("radioInput must have optionsInputs");
      }
      if (field.optionsInputs[options[0].value]) {
        // We don't show the label in this case because the optionInput itself will decide what label to show
        noLabel = true;
      } else {
        // If there's only one option and it doesn't have an input, we don't show the field at all because it's visible in the left side bar
        hidden = true;
      }
    }
  }

  /**
```

```typescript
function getAndUpdateNormalizedValuesExtracted(field: RhfFormFields[number], noLabel: boolean, hidden: boolean) {
  if (field.type === "radioInput") {
    const options = field.options;

    // If we have only one option and it has an input, we don't show the field label because Option name acts as label.
    // e.g. If it's just Attendee Phone Number option then we don't show `Location` label
    if (options?.length === 1) {
      if (!field.optionsInputs) {
        throw new Error("radioInput must have optionsInputs");
      }
      if (field.optionsInputs[options[0].value]) {
        // We don't show the label in this case because the optionInput itself will decide what label to show
        noLabel = true;
      } else {
        // If there's only one option and it doesn't have an input, we don't show the field at all because it's visible in the left side bar
        hidden = true;
      }
    }
  }
  return { noLabel, hidden };
}
```

```typescript
export async function scheduleNoShowTaskForBooking(
  booking: { id: number; uid: string; startTime: Date; location: string | null },
  webhook: Webhook,
  triggerEvent: WebhookTriggerEvents
) {
  if (!webhook.time || !webhook.timeUnit || !booking.startTime || !booking.location) return;

  const isCalVideoLocation = booking.location === DailyLocationType || booking.location?.trim() === "";
  if (!isCalVideoLocation) return;

  if (
    triggerEvent !== WebhookTriggerEvents.AFTER_HOSTS_CAL_VIDEO_NO_SHOW &&
    triggerEvent !== WebhookTriggerEvents.AFTER_GUESTS_CAL_VIDEO_NO_SHOW
  )
    return;

  const scheduledAt = dayjs(booking.startTime)
    .add(webhook.time ?? 0, webhook.timeUnit?.toLowerCase() as dayjs.ManipulateType)
    .toDate();

  const taskType =
    triggerEvent === WebhookTriggerEvents.AFTER_HOSTS_CAL_VIDEO_NO_SHOW
      ? "triggerHostNoShowWebhook"
      : "triggerGuestNoShowWebhook";
  const version = (webhook.version as WebhookVersion) ?? DEFAULT_WEBHOOK_VERSION;
  await tasker.create(
    taskType,
    {
      triggerEvent,
      bookingId: booking.id,
      webhook: {
        ...webhook,
        time: webhook.time ?? 0,
        timeUnit: webhook.timeUnit ?? "HOUR",
        version,
      },
    },
    {
      scheduledAt,
      referenceUid: booking.uid,
    }
  );
}

async function cancelNoShowTasksForBookingDeleteMany(webhook: Pick<Webhook, "id" | "userId" | "teamId" | "eventTypeId"> | undefined) {
  if (webhook) {
    const bookings = await fetchBookingsFromWebhook(webhook);

    if (bookings.length === 0) return { value: undefined };

    const promises = bookings.map(async (booking) => {
      return await prisma.task.deleteMany({
        where: {
          referenceUid: booking.uid,
        },
      });
    });

    await Promise.all(promises);
  }
  return null;
}
```

### Fix Group 2: SecondaryEmailConfirmModal.tsx: SC 2.1.1, SC 4.1.2, wcag

#### Findings

4 compliance findings in `apps/web/components/settings/SecondaryEmailConfirmModal.tsx`.

#### Remediation

- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <DialogClose> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value (Name, Role, Value):** <DialogClose> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Add an appropriate role attribute (e.g., role="button", role="link", role="tab").
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <DialogClose> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <DialogClose> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy

### Fix Group 2: CheckedSelect.tsx: SC 2.1.1, SC 4.1.2, wcag

#### Findings

4 compliance findings in `apps/web/components/ui/form/CheckedSelect.tsx`.

#### Remediation

- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <Icon> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value (Name, Role, Value):** <Icon> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Add an appropriate role attribute (e.g., role="button", role="link", role="tab").

  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy

  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy

### Fix Group 2: PendingReportsColumns.tsx: SC 1.1.1, SC 2.1.1, SC 4.1.2 +2 more

#### Findings

10 compliance findings in `apps/web/modules/blocklist/components/PendingReportsColumns.tsx`.

#### Remediation

- **wcag-1.1.1-icon-label (Non-text Content):** Interactive <DropdownMenuTrigger> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add visible text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby to provide an accessible name.
- **wcag-1.1.1-icon-label (Non-text Content):** Interactive <Button> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add visible text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby to provide an accessible name.
- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <DropdownItem> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value (Name, Role, Value):** <DropdownItem> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Add an appropriate role attribute (e.g., role="button", role="link", role="tab").
- **sonde/i18n.hardcoded-string (Hard-coded user-facing string):** Hard-coded user-facing string: "Select all" (jsx-attr:aria-label)
  - Fix: Wrap the string with the project's active i18n framework (`msg()`, `<Trans>`, `t!`, etc.).
- **sonde/i18n.hardcoded-string (Hard-coded user-facing string):** Hard-coded user-facing string: "Select row" (jsx-attr:aria-label)
  - Fix: Wrap the string with the project's active i18n framework (`msg()`, `<Trans>`, `t!`, etc.).
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** Interactive <DropdownMenuTrigger> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** Interactive <Button> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <DropdownItem> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy

### Fix Group 2: CustomEmailTextField.tsx: SC 1.1.1, SC 1.3.1, SC 2.1.1 +2 more

#### Findings

14 compliance findings in `apps/web/components/settings/CustomEmailTextField.tsx`.

#### Remediation

- **wcag-1.1.1-icon-label (Non-text Content):** Interactive <DropdownMenuTrigger> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add visible text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby to provide an accessible name.
- **wcag-1.1.1-icon-label (Non-text Content):** Interactive <Button> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add visible text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby to provide an accessible name.
- **wcag-1.3.1-form-label (Info and Relationships):** <Input> is missing an accessible label (no <label>, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add a <label for="id">, aria-label, or aria-labelledby attribute.
- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <DropdownItem> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <DropdownItem> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.

  - Fix: Add an appropriate role attribute (e.g., role="button", role="link", role="tab").
- **wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value (Name, Role, Value):** <DropdownItem> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.

### Fix Group 2: oauth-clients-view.tsx: SC 2.1.1, SC 4.1.2, wcag

4 compliance findings in `apps/web/modules/settings/developer/oauth-clients-view.tsx`.
